rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); RuntimeEffectCache refuses caller SkSL that declares a local named pos in main(), which on the pinned Skia breaks only on Graphite (compile failure then a crash in the recording submit, or shadowed coordinates rendering black), with a line-numbered diagnostic on every backend; every iOS CADisplayLink (IOSRenderLoop and the window and plug-in view hosts) requests the screen's maximum frame rate while frames are drawn and returns to the default after sustained idle, through a pure DisplayRateBoost policy in pulp/render/render_loop.hpp and an iOS-only apply_display_rate_change helper. No public API is removed and no design-import, Chromium, rendering, packaging, or source-authority boundary moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'Graphite still shadows the coordinates with an author local named pos'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'Runtime-effect names Graphite reserves are refused or render as written'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'compile_sksl refuses a local named pos in main on every backend'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'ios-auv3 templates opt out of the 60 Hz iPhone frame cap'
